name: Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Conjure a cauldron that brews copies of a Common or Uncommon potion you know.
text: It holds as many potions as your spellcasting modifier (at least one); drawing one is a Bonus Action. Potions that aren't used vanish when you cast the spell again.
